(() => { const text = document.querySelector('[data-readout]').textContent; if(text !== '22° · Lights off') throw new Error(text); return 'Home controls pass: ' + text; })()

(() => { if(document.querySelector('figure[data-finish]').dataset.finish !== 'Rose') throw new Error('Finish failed'); if(document.querySelector('[data-readout]').textContent !== 'Preview playing') throw new Error('Player failed'); return 'Keyboard finish and music controls pass'; })()

(() => { const time = document.querySelector('[class*=digitalTime]').textContent; const expected = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}).format(new Date()); if(time !== expected) throw new Error('Clock mismatch'); const headings = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h2')).map(h=>h.textContent); if(headings.indexOf('HomeView')+1 !== headings.indexOf('Projects')) throw new Error('Order failed'); return {clock:time, order:'HomeView before Projects', overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth}; })()
